examples.label: Expressions
examples.purpose: The parser asks for one token at a time; the scanner bites off the next lexeme and skips white space. The look-ahead shows when it is called.

examples.label: Keywords and identifiers
examples.purpose: print is a keyword, printer an identifier: the longest match wins, and on a tie the earlier rule (the keyword) does.

examples.label: < against <=
examples.purpose: One character of look-ahead decides: after < the scanner reads the next character, and gives it back when it is not =.

examples.label: Integer and real literals
examples.purpose: 1.5 is one token, but in 1.+2 the scanner reads the point, finds no digit after it, gives it back and returns the integer 1.

examples.label: Evaluate expressions
examples.purpose: Each rule computes the value $$ of its left side from $1, $2, … of its right side when the parser reduces: a node's value is known as it is built.

examples.label: Three-address code (quadruples)
examples.purpose: Every operator gets a fresh temporary; emit appends a quadruple (operator, two arguments, result). The order of the quadruples is the order of the reductions.
examples.text:
<expr> → <expr> '+' <term> {{ $$.place = newtemp(); emit('+', $1.place, $3.place, $$.place) }}
  | <expr> '-' <term> {{ $$.place = newtemp(); emit('-', $1.place, $3.place, $$.place) }}
  | <term>
<term> → <term> '*' <factor> {{ $$.place = newtemp(); emit('*', $1.place, $3.place, $$.place) }}
  | <term> '/' <factor> {{ $$.place = newtemp(); emit('/', $1.place, $3.place, $$.place) }}
  | <factor>
<factor> → '(' <expr> ')' {{ $$.place = $2.place }}
  | num {{ $$.place = $1.lexeme }}
  | id {{ $$.place = $1.lexeme }}

examples.label: Translation to postfix
examples.purpose: A translation into a string: the value of a node is the postfix text of its subtree.

groups.label: Attributes, types and the symbol table

examples.label: Types from literals and operators
examples.purpose: Types are computed bottom-up: int and float literals; an operator widens to float when an operand is float, with a conversion quadruple.
examples.text:
<prog> → <stmts>
<stmts> → <stmts> <stmt> | <stmt>
<stmt> → id '=' <expr> ';' {{ install($1.lexeme, $3.type); emit('=', $3.place, '', $1.lexeme) }}
<expr> → <expr> '+' <term> {{ $$.type = widen($1.type, $3.type); a = coerce($1.place, $1.type, $$.type); b = coerce($3.place, $3.type, $$.type); $$.place = newtemp(); emit('+', a, b, $$.place) }}
  | <expr> '-' <term> {{ $$.type = widen($1.type, $3.type); a = coerce($1.place, $1.type, $$.type); b = coerce($3.place, $3.type, $$.type); $$.place = newtemp(); emit('-', a, b, $$.place) }}
  | <term>
<term> → <term> '*' <factor> {{ $$.type = widen($1.type, $3.type); a = coerce($1.place, $1.type, $$.type); b = coerce($3.place, $3.type, $$.type); $$.place = newtemp(); emit('*', a, b, $$.place) }}
  | <term> '/' <factor> {{ $$.type = widen($1.type, $3.type); a = coerce($1.place, $1.type, $$.type); b = coerce($3.place, $3.type, $$.type); $$.place = newtemp(); emit('/', a, b, $$.place) }}
  | <factor>
<factor> → '(' <expr> ')' {{ $$.type = $2.type; $$.place = $2.place }}
  | int {{ $$.type = int; $$.place = $1.lexeme }}
  | float {{ $$.type = float; $$.place = $1.lexeme }}
  | id {{ require(lookup($1.lexeme) != '', 'undeclared variable ' + $1.lexeme); $$.type = lookup($1.lexeme); $$.place = $1.lexeme }}

examples.label: Declarations and assignments
examples.purpose: Declarations install types. An assignment looks the variable up, converts int to float, and reports undeclared names and float-to-int assignments.
examples.text:
<prog> → <items>
<items> → <items> <item> | <item>
<item> → <decl> | <stmt>
<decl> → integer id ';' {{ install($2.lexeme, int) }}
  | real id ';' {{ install($2.lexeme, float) }}
<stmt> → id '=' <expr> ';' {{ t = lookup($1.lexeme); require(t != '', 'undeclared variable ' + $1.lexeme); require(not (t == int and $3.type == float), 'cannot assign a real to the integer ' + $1.lexeme); emit('=', coerce($3.place, $3.type, t), '', $1.lexeme) }}
<expr> → <expr> '+' <term> {{ $$.type = widen($1.type, $3.type); a = coerce($1.place, $1.type, $$.type); b = coerce($3.place, $3.type, $$.type); $$.place = newtemp(); emit('+', a, b, $$.place) }}
  | <expr> '-' <term> {{ $$.type = widen($1.type, $3.type); a = coerce($1.place, $1.type, $$.type); b = coerce($3.place, $3.type, $$.type); $$.place = newtemp(); emit('-', a, b, $$.place) }}
  | <term>
<term> → <term> '*' <factor> {{ $$.type = widen($1.type, $3.type); a = coerce($1.place, $1.type, $$.type); b = coerce($3.place, $3.type, $$.type); $$.place = newtemp(); emit('*', a, b, $$.place) }}
  | <term> '/' <factor> {{ $$.type = widen($1.type, $3.type); a = coerce($1.place, $1.type, $$.type); b = coerce($3.place, $3.type, $$.type); $$.place = newtemp(); emit('/', a, b, $$.place) }}
  | <factor>
<factor> → '(' <expr> ')' {{ $$.type = $2.type; $$.place = $2.place }}
  | int {{ $$.type = int; $$.place = $1.lexeme }}
  | float {{ $$.type = float; $$.place = $1.lexeme }}
  | id {{ require(lookup($1.lexeme) != '', 'undeclared variable ' + $1.lexeme); $$.type = lookup($1.lexeme); $$.place = $1.lexeme }}
strings: integer x; real y; x = 1; y = x * 2.5;
